zh: 新增邮箱验证码登录；邮箱账号可关联 GitHub
个人中心重构为统一账户中心：可查看 AI 用量
收藏支持云端同步（需登录）
AI 对话新增多会话切换、联网搜索与 Deep Research
AI 回答的代码高亮与表格排版升级；主题配色重做，支持自定义
en: Email code sign-in added; email accounts can link a GitHub account
Profile rebuilt into a unified account center, with AI usage at a glance
Favorites now sync to the cloud (sign-in required)
AI chat adds multi-session switching, web search, and Deep Research
Better code highlighting and tables in answers; reworked themes with custom colors
